title: checklist: give three Studio items the boot fixtures their steps need (two launch entries, one showcase picklist)
body:
domain:devx#2 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gLghEqeDKTbDTC7Zd

Filing gate: ① follow-up owed by landed work (#29679 / PR #29815), checklist tri-state ②: three items' steps cannot reach the path their title asserts, so every run scores them partial or blocked.
Reader: domain:devx seat, next PR that touches `.claude/launch.json` and `examples/app-showcase/objectstack.config.ts` (two slices if the launch half is governed)
Dedupe (open AND closed): "launch.json OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED", "OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED launch", "picklist-bound-select", "flow-status-matches-runtime", "custom-page-source-tiers" → 0 cards for this gap (hits are #29679, QA run records, and closed #21957 which added the item)
reach: QA run #29672 at 3482f3d8d2 scored the three items below without driving their path
QA-source: #29672 · studio-authoring · flow-status-matches-runtime, custom-page-source-tiers, picklist-bound-select
Checklist item priority: inherits each item's
type: Task

## Why

The QA run of 2026-11-03 could not drive three studio-authoring items. Each one needs the server booted with something the checklist's own fixture declarations cannot provide. #29679 was scoped to re-point clauses only, and its order says a gap that needs a governed or seed-data change gets reported, not patched. So the three items stay partial or blocked on every run, and that costs a human read each time. This card is that report.

## The gaps (named by #29679's table; the #29679 dev confirmed on main `339f63da30` that no checklist fixture declaration can hold them)

1. **`flow-status-matches-runtime`** needs a boot with `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED=1`. A runner that can start servers only from `.claude/launch.json` has no such entry.
2. **`custom-page-source-tiers`** needs a boot with `OS_PAGE_REACT_ENABLED=false`. `.claude/launch.json` has no such entry either.
3. **`picklist-bound-select`** needs a package picklist plus an object extension that binds a field to it in `examples/app-showcase/objectstack.config.ts`. Until the showcase ships them, every run scores the item blocked.

`.claude/launch.json` is a governed surface (Tier S); check `check-governed-merges --pr N` on the final file list. The picklist fixture is a seed-data change to the showcase.

## Acceptance notes

- Each item's `fixtures.requires` names the new launch entry or seed artefact by name, with a revision bump and a history row.
- A run that boots from `.claude/launch.json` reaches each item's path. Score the three items again on the next studio-authoring run.
